patch_description: The current program crashes on `None`-cost edges in Dijkstra in some configs and, per the recommendation, backfilling `cost=None` edges with a large-but-finite penalty (1e6) before pathfinding unlocks stable shortest-path computation without changing behavior on priced edges. I apply this backfill, plus a small per-dst multiplicative random perturbation to occasionally discover cheaper parallel routes, keeping the same simple per-partition path assignment structure for safety.
